regime.label: Risk-off
regime.text: Risk-off. BTC is −4.6% over 24h and −0.3% over the last 3 hours, trading below its 15m EMA21; ETH is −5.8% on the day. 3% of coins are up over 24h (median −9.7%) and 2% have a rising 1h trend. Long setups fail more often in this tape; cut size or wait.

strategies.name: VWAP reclaim
strategies.desc: Price traded below the 24h VWAP in the last two hours and closes back above it on 1.3x+ volume while the 1h trend is not down. Buy at VWAP; stop under the 2-hour low.

strategies.name: Smart-money follow
strategies.desc: At least 70% of the money Hyperliquid's top traders hold in the coin is long ($250K+ from 5+ traders, not reduced since the last scan) and price is above EMA50. Buy near EMA21.

strategies.name: EMA21 trend pullback
strategies.desc: Bullish EMA 9/21/50 stack with a rising EMA21; price dips into the EMA9-EMA21 area with RSI 42-66. Stop under EMA50 or the last swing low.
strategies.why: 43% winners, -0.17R per trade, profit factor 0.68 over 250 trades; +0.01R per trade against random entries

strategies.name: Trend continuation (EMA9 dip)
strategies.desc: Strong trend (ADX 22+, +DI over -DI, RSI 58-80) within 2% of the 24h high. Buy dips to EMA9; stop under EMA21 and the last swing low.
strategies.why: 38% winners, -0.30R per trade, profit factor 0.50 over 194 trades; -0.11R per trade against random entries

strategies.name: Squeeze break
strategies.desc: Bollinger width in the tightest quarter of the day while price holds the top of a rising 3-hour range. Buy only after a 15m close above the range high.
strategies.why: 38% winners, -0.35R per trade, profit factor 0.45 over 37 trades; +0.14R per trade against random entries

strategies.name: Range breakout retest
strategies.desc: A 15m close above the prior 8-hour range high on strong volume. Buy the retest of the broken high; stop under the level and the breakout candle.
strategies.why: 37% winners, -0.37R per trade, profit factor 0.41 over 62 trades; +0.03R per trade against random entries

strategies.name: Oversold bounce in an uptrend
strategies.desc: The 1h trend is up but the 15m RSI is 32 or lower (or price sits on the lower Bollinger band) within 1.5 ATR of a swing low, and the candle is turning up. Quick targets; stop under the low.
strategies.why: 47% winners, -0.37R per trade, profit factor 0.33 over 34 trades; -0.19R per trade against random entries

strategies.name: 24-hour high breakout
strategies.desc: A 15m close above the prior 24-hour high on 2x+ volume. Buy the retest of the old high; stop 1 ATR under it. Wider targets for a fresh daily breakout.
strategies.why: 31% winners, -0.41R per trade, profit factor 0.41 over 45 trades; +0.11R per trade against random entries

strategies.name: EMA9/21 bull cross
strategies.desc: EMA9 crossed above EMA21 in the last three candles with +DI over -DI, price above VWAP and RSI 50-72. Buy near EMA21; stop under the 2-hour low.
strategies.why: 38% winners, -0.42R per trade, profit factor 0.37 over 16 trades; -0.72R per trade against random entries; stays rejected until it makes money again (profit factor 1.05+)

mistakes.label: Chased: price far above EMA21 or above the zone
No volume behind the move (under 1.2x normal)
Stopped out, then price hit TP1 within 3 hours (stop too tight)
mistakes.fix: watched per strategy: a stop widens 10% when 35%+ of its recent stops were hunted

mistakes.label: No red flags: a normal loss
Late: the coin was already up 25%+ in 24h
Stopped within 30 minutes of the fill (failed breakout)
mistakes.fix: counted in each breakout strategy's record, which decides whether it stays published
